name: Clean
description: A light, neutral style for documents, with a blue primary color and an amber accent.

guidance.notes: Plain white pages with a calm blue as the main color. Use amber only to point at one thing.
do: Keep generous margins of at least 16 pixels.
Round the corners of cards by 12 pixels.
dont: Do not use gradients or shadows.
Do not use more than one accent color in a picture.

examples.examples/title-card.svg: A title card with a heading, a line of text, and an accent bar.
examples.examples/flow.mmd: A flowchart with the Mermaid theme of the kit.
examples.examples/chart.vl.json: A bar chart with the Vega-Lite configuration of the kit.
